verdict_one_line: Stage 1 is scientifically adequate to proceed to P2 ranking: the accepted set is broad (156 clusters, max share 1.15%), genre-balanced, honestly labeled, citation-clean, and its GATE-5-compliant core (726 w3-w5 records) alone exceeds the 200-idea Stage-2 target 3.6x; the tracked debts (431 soft w1/w2 thresholds, 287 unpinned assets, 100% novelty unverified) are remediation items for P2/Stage-2 lanes, not blockers.

1_falsifiability_and_kill_thresholds.reading: The window's own GATE-5 numeric-kill standard is met almost perfectly from w3 onward (726 records at 97.5-100%); waves 1-2 predate the standard and are directionally falsifiable (comparative/monotonicity predictions) but numerically soft. Sampled w1/w2 records (e.g. D-030) state a testable direction and a one-day protocol yet no pre-registered kill number.
1_falsifiability_and_kill_thresholds.gate1_note: 7 gen_k + O-007 carry decisive thresholds in words ('factor of two', 'one-quarter') - flagged transparently, numeric-format retrofit owed, no numbers invented

2_cheap_kill_quality.cost_or_time_estimate_present: 986/1220 (~81%); w4 296/296 and w5 286/286 include explicit GPU-hours/days and often dollar caps; w2 weakest at 73/246
2_cheap_kill_quality.reading: w5 exemplars (O-002: SQUID + Depth Anything, <4 GPU-hours, ~$8; O-007: FathomNet + DINOv2 probe, ~10 GPU-hours) show the intended cheap-kill form. The asset-pinning debt is real but explicitly flagged per-record (gate4_deferred/gate4_missing) and owed to the Stage-2 retrofit lane - it is tracked, not hidden.

7_adjudication_honesty.gate5_repair_lane: 46 repaired gen_g/gen_h records carry extraction provenance; 127 non-extractable records remanded off-master rather than padded with invented thresholds - the window preferred losing count to inventing numbers, which is the right failure mode

adequacy_to_proceed_to_p2.rationale: P2 ranking (1220 -> 200) is a selection step that can and should consume the quality gradient this audit measured. The GATE-5-compliant w3-w5 core (726 records, 97.5-100% numeric kills, 100% cost-estimated in w4/w5) alone exceeds the 200 target by 3.6x, so no soft record needs to advance by necessity. Diversity is structurally sound (156 clusters, 1.15% max share, 6.6% SAM share, balanced genre mix). Honesty machinery (labels, dissents, remands, unverified-novelty flags) is intact with zero fabrication found. Requiring every w1/w2 record to be retrofitted before ranking would invert the funnel's economics for records most of which will be eliminated anyway.

remediation_items: R1: 431 records (176 w1 + 237 w2 + 15 w3 + 3 w4) lack numeric kill thresholds; P2 rankers must down-rank on falsifiability or numeric-retrofit any such record before it enters the 200-survivor list; soft w1/w2 records must not displace GATE-5-compliant records on topic novelty alone
R2: 287 gate4_deferred records lack pinned public dataset+model; Stage-2 retrofit lane owed (per-record gate4_missing lists exist)
R3: novelty is 100% unverified; a GATE-8 novelty screen is mandatory before Stage-2 exit, with O-002/O-031 and the 141 preserved dissents first in line

R4: fairness/bias-social (~1 record) and inference-time compute (~3) territories are effectively unfilled (gen_u never dispatched; gen_q off-master); embodied (17) and continual/lifecycle (10) thin - P2 should protect these records from volume-based elimination and later stages should note the portfolio cannot yield a top-3 in those territories without new generation

R5: 127 accepted gen_g/gen_h records remain remanded off-master (wave_b_w3_gate5/remaining_remand.jsonl, re-verified 127 lines); restoration/domain-shift are underweighted relative to generated volume; the queue must not be silently dropped
R6: 8 gate1_qualitative_threshold records (7 gen_k + O-007) owe a numeric-format retrofit (thresholds decisive but stated in words)

R7 (process, for Meta-Judge): the w5 consolidator recorded that the diversity_audit_w3 consolidator (over the 934 master) must merge before stage1_completion auditors dispatch; at the audited commit auditors A+B of that wave were on origin but C + consolidator were pending - Meta-Judge should confirm ordering or explicitly waive
